goal: Wire a per-attempt LoopGuard into the harness so a STUCK verdict aborts to interrupted (blocked, retry preserved) and a THRASH verdict aborts to failed_validation, each emitting its harness.* audit event.

references: src/flywheel/harness.py:1816-1939 -- _drive_iterations + the per-iteration loop; feed guard.observe(iteration_result.signals.tool_interactions) after each iteration returns
src/flywheel/harness.py:1602-1692 -- explicit-blocked path (Outcome.CANCELLED + Blocked domain event + INTERRUPTED, retry budget NOT consumed); STUCK reuses this exact shape
src/flywheel/harness.py:1764-1786 -- cap-reached agent-error path (VALIDATING -> Outcome.AGENT_ERROR -> FAILED_VALIDATION); THRASH reuses this exact shape
src/flywheel/harness.py:1297-1362 -- retry arm (is_retry_eligible -> READY/FAILED) that THRASH's FAILED_VALIDATION feeds
src/flywheel/harness.py:218-278 -- HarnessConfig, add a loop_guard: LoopGuardConfig field
src/flywheel/harness.py:1480-1513 -- _run_attempt_body, where the guard is constructed before _drive_iterations
constraints: Add loop_guard: LoopGuardConfig field to HarnessConfig with a default that preserves today's behavior; construct one LoopGuard from config.loop_guard per attempt (fresh per attempt, no cross-attempt state) and feed it each completed iteration's signals.tool_interactions in arrival order.

FR-1 STUCK: on a STUCK verdict, abort the iteration loop and finalize with Outcome.CANCELLED, emit harness.stuck (payload names the tool_name and input digest), record a Blocked domain event with a synthesized requires_json describing the failing tool, and transition running -> interrupted. The retry budget MUST NOT be consumed (mirror the explicit-blocked path).

FR-2 THRASH: on a THRASH verdict, abort and finalize with Outcome.AGENT_ERROR, emit harness.thrash_detected (payload names tool_name + digest), and transition running -> validating -> failed_validation so the existing retry arm applies is_retry_eligible (READY with retries remaining, else FAILED).
FR-6: a stream that satisfies BOTH thresholds lands in interrupted (STUCK wins) -- this follows from loop_guard precedence, but assert it end-to-end.
FR-5: with config.loop_guard detectors disabled the harness behaves exactly as today; a thrashing stream then runs to the normal cap-reached agent-error outcome.
Repeated-failure that trips on the final allowed iteration still routes to interrupted (the block signal preempts the cap-reached outcome).
If LoopGuard.observe raises, let it propagate to the _run_attempt boundary (recorded via the existing crash path) -- do not swallow it.

Add harness tests covering each of: three identical failing Bash calls (threshold 3) -> interrupted with exactly one harness.stuck naming tool+digest, is_retry_eligible unchanged, and an operator transition to ready clears blocked_requires_json; an identical successful call repeated past the threshold within the window -> failed_validation, then ready when max_retries>=1 and failed when max_retries==0; both-thresholds stream -> interrupted; detectors-disabled thrash stream -> normal cap-reached outcome.
FR-7: assert harness.stuck and harness.thrash_detected round-trip verbatim through flywheel.audit.stream(run_id) under the run's monotonic sequence.

SHARED-INVARIANT: thrash/repeated-failure default ON. Verify the full existing harness suite still passes under default config -- if any existing fixture trips a detector, the defaults are too aggressive; pick thresholds that leave the current suite green rather than editing fixtures to dodge a real trip.
Call mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on src/flywheel/harness.py and any touched test file and fix all type errors before verify.
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No changes to flywheel.loop_guard detection logic.
No new flywheel.events domain-event type -- reuse the existing Blocked domain event; the new signals are harness.* audit events only.
edge_cases: max_iterations_per_attempt == 1 still feeds the single iteration's intra-iteration tuple sequence to observe -- a within-turn repeat can trip.
An iteration with zero tool interactions feeds an empty sequence and changes nothing.

graders.run: uv run pytest tests/test_harness.py -k "stuck or thrash or loop_guard"
graders.name: wiring-tests
